_about: Episode 3 music-mix demo clip for the design gate (voice + music), same style-C engine as Episode 2.

engine.stubbed: none needed; scene structure replaced by one constant-tempo 'curious' section (full drive, gain 0 dB); cold-open restrained 'cold' style not used so the mix demo shows the full bed

voice.processing: gain only (master gain), mono on both channels, no stretch or shift

swell.shape: ramp 0.3 s from 41.9 s, hold to 44.2 s, ramp down 0.3 s

music.level: 20 dB under voice over voice-active windows; 1-4 kHz ducked 13 dB (80 ms look-ahead)

measure.measuredWith: ffmpeg ebur128=peak=true on the decoded music-clip.m4a (and on the pre-encode master); true-peak limiter ceiling -1.5
measure.musicUnderVoiceHow: A07 method (a07_gap): mean power of voice stem minus music stem over 100 ms windows where voice > -45 dBFS, on the pre-encode stems

T2_musicSelfSimilarity.input: music-only-clip.m4a with a tempo map of constant 114 BPM beats from 0 (scratchpad tempo-map.json, same fixed grid the engine used)
T2_musicSelfSimilarity.caveat: 58 s gives only 6 four-bar phrases / 5 pairs, so the share is very coarse; the tool prints no single percentage, 0.40 is the share of pairs >= 0.90 (Ep1 29%, Ep2 19.7% are on full-length edits). Mean similarity 0.873.

musicOnly.note: music stem at its in-mix gain (room tone excluded)
